questions.prompt: What .NET type does `Get-Process` emit per row?
Why does `| Where-Object { $_.WS -gt 100MB }` work while `grep` cannot filter that way?

options.a: Where-Object filters live objects by property; grep sees only formatted text
options.b: grep is restricted by file permissions

questions.prompt: In `Get-Process | grep pwsh`, what reaches `grep`'s stdin?

options.a: Strings (the formatted text display), not objects
